steps.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
from vlb_traj import Session
import json, os
out='/app/output/trajectory.npz'
with Session() as s:
    s.record_start()
    print('PICK BEGIN', flush=True)
    p=s.skill('pick', target_entity_name='mickey')
    print('PICK RESULT', json.dumps(p, indent=2), flush=True)
    print('AFTER PICK', json.dumps(s.state(), indent=2), flush=True)
    if not s.status().get('success'):
        print('PLACE BEGIN', flush=True)
        q=s.skill('place', target_container_name='giftbox_seen')
        print('PLACE RESULT', json.dumps(q, indent=2), flush=True)
    print('FINAL STATUS', json.dumps(s.status(), indent=2), flush=True)
    actions=s.record_stop()
    print('RECORDED ACTIONS', actions.shape, flush=True)
    s.save_trajectory(actions, out)
    print('SAVED', out, os.path.getsize(out), flush=True)
PY
